# Third-Party Notice for Test Fixtures

This directory contains test fixtures that are NOT original to this project. Each

---

## jpx-codec.pdf

- **original**: `pdf.js test/pdfs/bug_jpx.pdf`
- **source**: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js — test corpus
- **license**: Apache-2.0 (the pdf.js project is Apache-2.0 licensed)
- **purpose**: PDF rendering regression fixture for a JPEG2000 (JPXDecode) image,
  which exercises the OpenJPEG WASM decoder path under `wasmUrl`. Used by
  `scripts/test-pdf-codec.mjs` (non-white content assertion) — without the shared
  PDF.js runtime config this page renders pure white.
- **size**: ~5.4 KB

## jpeg-image.pdf

- **original**: generated locally by this project's own fixture generator
  (`test/.playwright/make-jpeg-pdf.mjs`) for this project's tests.
- **license**: original to this project (MIT).
- **purpose**: control fixture — a normal (DCT) JPEG image PDF that must render
  non-white. Confirms the "normal JPEG" path (no WASM needed) is unaffected.

## outline-sample.pdf / outline-tricky.pdf / no-outline.pdf

- Generated by this project's own PDF generators (see `scripts/make-outline-*.mjs`,
  `test/.playwright/make-pdf.mjs`). Original to this project (MIT), used for outline
  parsing, chapter navigation and Reader tests.

---

### PDF.js redistribution (public/pdfjs)

The `public/pdfjs/{wasm,cmaps,standard_fonts,iccs}` directories are verbatim copies of
the auxiliary runtime assets shipped inside the `pdfjs-dist` npm package (Apache-2.0).
The bundled `openjpeg.wasm` / `jbig2.wasm` / `qcms_bg.wasm` decoders are separately
licensed (OpenJPEG: BSD-2-Clause; JBIG2: Apache-2.0; qcms: MIT) and their LICENSE files
are carried alongside in `public/pdfjs/wasm`. Their exact provenance and licenses are
preserved by leaving those files and license texts intact.
